title: Glowing people in sunlight need a self-halo, not bloom
summary: Bloom can't isolate glowing figures on a brighter sunlit floor. What worked: no tone mapping, cap .97, linear colours, roughness 1 / no env, a hotter yellow rim, 3 additive halo shells.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Glowing/x-ray figures in daylight or bright sets.
doc.avoid: Bloom strength as the glow; a sun specular on the figures; strong halo opacity (they read see-through).
gotchas: Each shell needs its own customProgramCacheKey.

problem.symptom: The figures don't glow; they look peach, pale or see-through in a sunlit scene.
problem.cause: Bloom thresholds pick the brighter ground; tone mapping and the grade cap flatten the emissive; the sun's specular adds white.
problem.fix: toneMapped false, cap .97, linear colours, roughness 1 + envMapIntensity 0, a hot rim ramp, additive back-face halo shells.
problem.detect: Region means of the figures vs the reference (G/R ratio, brightness vs the floor).
